sources.snippet:
This page is about the virtual pet. For the comic book series, see Tamagotchi Paradise (Comic book).

Tamagotchi Paradise(たまごっちパラダイス

Tamagotchi Paradaisu) is a color-screen virtual pet released by Bandai worldwide. It initially released on July 12th, 2025 in Japan, Australia, and parts of Europe, and released on August 1st, 2025 in North America. [...] The Tamagotchi Paradise has a color-screen, and the shell bears a visual resemblance to the Tamagotchi Pix in many ways, sharing a similar overall size and having printed graphics for the cracked-egg screen borders. The top half of the shell also has a cracked-egg design and is colored differently from the rest of the shell body; though, unlike the Pix, it can be flipped open and reveals a dock port for connection similar to the Tamagotchi Osutchi and Mesutchi. Unique to the Paradise is an [...] ## Literature\[]

### Tamagotchi Paradise\[]

Main article: Tamagotchi Paradise (Comic book)

Tamagotchi Paradise is a comic book series in May 3rd, 2025 on Free Comic Book Day. The series teased and promoted the Tamagotchi Paradise before its announcement, introducing the backstory and general gameplay of the device through a Tamagotchi Lab researcher's perspective. The first episode was released both physically and online while further episodes were released exclusively online.
